description: Defines a template class TimerType for scheduling and managing timed callbacks, including nested classes for timed info and a thread worker, as well as a WatchDogType class for thread-based watchdog timers.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class for scheduling timed callbacks with thread support, including nested classes for timed info and thread worker.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimedInfo
classes.description: Holds scheduled time and content, with comparison operators and accessors.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimeWorker
classes.description: A thread class that runs the parent TimerType's process method.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: A thread class for watchdog timers that can be armed, reset, and run a handler upon expiration.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a callback at a specific time with content.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all scheduled entries and blocks the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content entry is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a scheduled callback immediately, replacing existing if present.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a scheduled callback from the queue.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled callbacks.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main loop processing scheduled callbacks, handling execution and rescheduling.

methods.name: ScheduleEntry
methods.description: Inserts a timed info into the queue in order.

methods.name: Arm
methods.description: Arms the watchdog timer with a wait time and optional handler.
